notes.title: Maze Roller 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

We posted the Maze Roller 1.1 update earlier today!  This update includes an updated game engine that provides VR enhancements and optimizations.  In addition, it also fixes some issues reported by users using the Xbox One controller.  Happy Maze Rolling!

The Meerkat Gaming Team

notes.title: Small Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

We hope you're enjoying the Maze Roller Demo.  We just uploaded a small patch to fix 2 small issues.

- Pinwheel level not ending properly when you reach your cheese
- Redundant help text for motion controls when resetting camera view

Don't be shy in giving us feedback on the discussion boards and let us know if you encounter any other bugs.

Happy rolling!
